turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, good afternoon. Am I speaking with Mr. Reddy from Chennai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy. Who is this calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Ananya from Horizon Finance. I am calling to offer you a premium credit card with a limit of twenty five thousand rupees to start with.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Credit card? I do not need any more cards, I already have one from my bank.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand, sir. But this particular card has zero annual fees and very good rewards for grocery shopping.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know... these things are very confusing for me. What are the charges?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There are no joining charges at all, Mr. Reddy. It is a completely free offer for selected customers.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can you just send me the details on WhatsApp or email? I need to show it to my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course, sir. I can send the brochure and the terms and conditions to your registered email right away.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, please do that. I will check it and tell you later.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That sounds perfect. I will send it now and you can take your time to decide.
